title: The Seminar
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "The Seminar," Andy organizes a business seminar to attract clients after a failed real estate seminar experience. Michael supports the event by adopting a Greek character named Mikanos. Despite setbacks such as Jim dropping out and some attendees expressing dissatisfaction, Andy recruits Kevin and Ryan as replacement speakers. The seminar features a variety of speeches, including Kevin's motivational talk and Creed's bizarre presentation. Andy struggles with closing sales but ultimately manages to sell small business packages with encouragement from Michael. Meanwhile, Erin seeks help with Scrabble and discusses a movie compromise with Gabe.
